ObjectName: Archduchess Isabelle hitting the bird during the shooting competition orgnised by the Guild of Crossbowmen
Artist: Antoon Sallaert
ImageDescription: On 15th May, 1615, during the annual shooting competititon run by the Guild of Crossbowmen, Archduchess Isabelle hit the bird placed on the spire on the church of Notre-Dame du Sablon. She was then proclaimed "queen" of the guild.
